note: صلاحیت centrally means ability/capability/capacity/talent. 'Gentleness; a good characteristic' is not an appropriate core modern definition.
خیر means goodness/well-being/welfare and is also used discourse-pragmatically as 'well/anyway'. Bare 'no' is misleading.
بھوت means ghost/spirit/demon. The insulting 'ugly man' sense is colloquial/derogatory and should not be presented without register qualification.
proposed_english: ghost; spirit; demon; ghost-like/ghastly person (derogatory, context-dependent)

note: روک is both a noun meaning stop/prevention/restraint and the verb stem/imperative 'stop!' from روکنا. 'Content word' is not a POS and the verb use is missing.
proposed_english: stop; prevention; restraint; stop! (stem/imperative of روکنا)

note: شہید centrally means martyr/martyred person. 'A lover; an injured person' are poetic/archaic peripheral senses and should not lead a general learner entry.
proposed_english: martyr; martyred person; one killed for a cause/faith (context-dependent)
force; strength; power; bill/invoice (loanword homograph, context-dependent)

note: داخلہ centrally means admission/entry/enrollment/entrance. 'Interior' is not the useful learner meaning of this noun.
زمانے is an inflected form of زمانہ and must explicitly give times/eras/ages rather than only inflection labels.
proposed_english: times; eras; ages; time/era (oblique/vocative singular, context-dependent)

note: Rekhta lists revenue/income/incomings/receipts as established standalone senses.
واحد means one/single/sole/only and is also the grammatical term singular. 'Single' alone is too narrow.
شوق commonly means interest/hobby/enthusiasm/desire/passion. The current archaic English 'ardor; alacrity, gaiety' misses the learner-relevant senses.
گزر is related to گزرنا and means passage/passing or functions as its stem ('pass/go by'); it can also refer to livelihood in constructions. 'Carrot' is simply incorrect (carrot = گاجر).
proposed_english: passage; passing; pass/go by (verb stem); livelihood (in constructions/context-dependent)

note: روزانہ means daily/every day and functions primarily as an adverb/adjective. Noun POS is unnecessary.
پا is the noun foot/leg and also the verb stem of پانا meaning get/obtain/find. The source says only 'stem' without the verb meaning.
proposed_english: foot; leg; get; obtain; find (verb stem of پانا, context-dependent)

note: حکمت centrally means wisdom/sagacity and can mean strategy/prudence or philosophy. 'Miracle; mystery' are not appropriate core meanings.
